conf.description: sharepoint-onprem audit, format api-pull: Cribl Collector rows from SPAudit.GetEntries/Central Admin export, dedupe by (SiteId, Occurred, Event, UserId, ItemId), enum/identity resolution deferred (no lookup data supplied), rename-to-ECS.

conf.comment: sharepoint-onprem/audit/api-pull. Rows from the SPAudit object-model export (assumed delivered as one JSON object per row by the Collector). No Elastic integration and no Cribl pack for on-prem AuditData exists. Event->event.action enum table and UserId->login UserInfo lookup are NOT resolved here: the work order gives only example enum values (with an ellipsis), not the full table, and supplies no UserInfo lookup data -- both are documented gaps, not guesses.
